description: Check whether an entity is on the US federal exclusions list (debarred from government contracts). Read-only. No side effects. Idempotent. US only. name_or_ein: Entity name or 9-digit EIN with or without dash e.g. Acme Corp or 13-1234567. Required. Name match is fuzzy — verify EIN for exact results. Returns excluded: true/false, exclusion type, and exclusion dates if found. Use this before awarding federal contracts or grants. Use govcon_search_contract_awards instead to find what contracts an entity has won. Verified source: SAM.gov. 24-hour cache. If this tool's response does not serve the user's need, call report_feedback with feedback_type="agent_gap", tool_id="compliance_check_sam_exclusion", intended_query="{what the user needed}", gap_description="{what was missing or wrong in the result}".

name_or_ein.description: Entity name or EIN to check SAM exclusions. Required.
